query:
UPDATE track_stages
                     SET status = 'done', source = $2, evidence = $3,
                         finished_at = $4::text::timestamptz, next_attempt_at = NULL,
                         last_error = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_class = NULL,
                         updated_at = now()
                     WHERE track_id = $1 AND stage = 'recording'
